title: Momotaro
subtitle: The Peach Boy

scenes.cover:
Let's begin our story.
Press Next, or swipe the picture to the left to turn the page.
scenes.s01: Long, long ago, in a village at the foot of the mountains, there lived an old man and an old woman.
scenes.s02: One day, the old man went up the mountain to gather firewood, and the old woman went down to the river to wash clothes.
scenes.s03: While she was washing, a great big peach came bobbing down the river: donburako, donburako!
scenes.s04: She carried the peach home. Just as they were about to cut it, it split open, and out came a healthy baby boy! He was born from a peach, or momo, so they named him Momotaro.
scenes.s05:
Momotaro grew up big and strong. One day he said, "The ogres of Onigashima keep stealing the village's treasure. I will go and stop them."
The old woman made him the best kibi-dango in all Japan: sweet millet dumplings for the journey.
scenes.s06:
Along the road came a dog.
"Momotaro, may I have one of the dumplings at your waist?"
"You may, if you come with me to stop the ogres."
scenes.s07: A little further on, a monkey came along. The monkey got a dumpling too, and joined them.
scenes.s08: Further still, a pheasant came gliding down from the sky. It got a dumpling as well, and joined the team.
scenes.s09: Momotaro and his friends boarded a boat and sailed across the wide sea toward Onigashima, the Island of Ogres.
scenes.s10:
The dog bit, the monkey scratched, and the pheasant pecked.
"We give up! We give up! We will never do bad things again," cried the ogres.
scenes.s11: Momotaro and his friends loaded the treasure onto a cart and brought it back to the village. The old man and the old woman were overjoyed.

end: And they all lived happily ever after.

say.momotaro-deal: Come with me, and it's yours!
